gold: Invasive squamous cell carcinoma arising in a seborrheic keratosis of the eyelid

selector.rationale: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts and proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells

rejected.label: Sebaceous carcinoma
rejected.why: Negative immunohistochemical stains for adipophilin and androgen receptor

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Proliferation of neoplastic squamous cells, not basal cells

support_spans: Classic-appearing hyperkeratotic lesion with many pseudohorn cysts
